# 75107 - Dual line receiver

Package DIP-14 · family 751xx · catalogue file [catalog/chips/75107.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/75107.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 43 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![75107 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/75107.png) | ![75107 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-75107.png) | ![75107 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-75107.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | VCC+ | power |  |  | +5 V |
| 13 | VCC- | power |  |  | -5 V |
| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 3 | NC | nc |  |  |  |
| 10 | NC | nc |  |  |  |
| 1 | 1A | analog |  |  | non-inverting differential line input, channel 1 |
| 2 | 1B | analog |  |  | inverting differential line input, channel 1 |
| 12 | 2A | analog |  |  | non-inverting differential line input, channel 2 |
| 11 | 2B | analog |  |  | inverting differential line input, channel 2 |
| 5 | 1G | enable | high |  | controls pins 4; when not enabled: high; strobe for channel 1: when 1G or S is low the output is high |
| 8 | 2G | enable | high |  | controls pins 9; when not enabled: high; strobe for channel 2 |
| 6 | S | enable | high |  | controls pins 4, 9; when not enabled: high; strobe common to both channels |
| 4 | 1Y | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 9 | 2Y | output |  | totem-pole |  |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 1Y = NOT ((1A - 1B &lt;= -25 mV) AND 1G AND S) | Output low only when the differential input is negative (A below B by at least 25 mV) and both strobes are high; high otherwise. |
| 9 | 2Y = NOT ((2A - 2B &lt;= -25 mV) AND 2G AND S) | Same for channel 2. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.4 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | VCC+ 4.75-5.25 V, VCC- -4.75 to -5.25 V, TA 0-70 C. Receiver input thresholds: VIDH 25 mV (output high when A-B &gt;= +25 mV), VIDL -25 mV; between them the output is indeterminate when both strobes are high. Differential input range -5 to +5 V, common-mode range -3 to +3 V. Strobe inputs: VIH 2 V, VIL 0.8 V. VOH min 2.4 V at Iload -400 uA. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC+ 5 V, VCC- -5 V, TA 25 C, RL 390 ohm, CL 50 pF.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A,B (differential) | Y | PLH | 17 | 25 |
| A,B (differential) | Y | PHL | 17 | 25 |
| G or S | Y | PLH | 10 | 15 |
| G or S | Y | PHL | 8 | 15 |

## Not known

- No minimum propagation delays printed.
- Datasheet read is the improved 'A' version (SN75107A/SN75108A), described as a direct replacement for the original; the original non-A datasheet was not read.

## Notes

Truth table: VID &gt;= 25 mV -&gt; H; -25 &lt; VID &lt; 25 mV -&gt; H unless both G and S high (then indeterminate); VID &lt;= -25 mV -&gt; L only with G and S both high. When only one channel is used, ground the other channel's inputs.

## Sources

- [TI The Interface Circuits Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1974, SN55107A/SN55108A/SN75107A/SN75108A (bulletin DL-S 7111224, Feb 1971)](https://bitsavers.mirrorservice.org/components/ti/_dataBooks/1974_TI_The_Interface_Data_Book_for_Design_Engineers_Second_Edition.pdf) - 4-6, 4-8, 4-9, 4-11 (PDF pages 70, 72, 73, 75); SN75107A
